messages:
Kari (marketing): Heads up — we want the release announcement live tomorrow 10am PT. Need: changelog link, docs link, canary window, benchmark narrative for blog, webinar CTA + seatlist + HubSpot routing. Who can own the eng handoff? cc @Aj

Aj Patel: I can own changelog + rollout timing. Will publish changelog draft by 6pm PT tonight. For canary do 10–11am with incremental %s; ops to confirm. @Leo can you point docs link to latest build?

Leo T: Docs team — will publish docs page + quickstart. I'll add a permanent link and a redirect shortlink. ETA 8pm PT. Will paste links when live.

Samir R: Bench note: we have two narratives — "latency per token" (hero) and "cost per 1k tokens with batching" (appendix). Recommend using latency chart for hero, cost table in appendix. I'll drop a 1-paragraph blurb by 5pm.

Maria G: For inbound leads, we need a dedicated landing page form + HubSpot webhook. Can ops create the routing? Also want webinar sign-up pre-populated with UTM params. Kari, I'll need the webinar seatlist CSV before EOD. @ops-bot @deploy-bot any blockers?

ops-bot: webhook created in staging at https://hooks.example.com/hubspot/rls-2026; will need final form redirect URL from marketing to flip to prod. Can also pre-populate UTMs when you provide params.

deploy-bot: Canary window slot reserved 10:00–10:30 PT. Automated rollout: 10% -> 50% -> pause. Manual rollback gate enabled.

Aj Patel: Ops noted. Kari, once Leo posts docs link, I'll update changelog with that URL and publish. Also propose we pin a 'known issues' note for first 24h.

Kari (marketing): Perfect. Quick checklist:
1) Aj: changelog draft by 6pm
2) Leo: docs link by 8pm
3) Samir: bench blurb by 5pm
4) Maria: landing page + HubSpot wiring (I'll share design)
5) Ops: webhook + routing
If everyone OK I'll assemble release post and soft-announce to beta list tonight. :thumbsup:

Aj Patel: OK. One ask: can we hold major rollout to 10:30am PT in case we need rollback? Suggest canary 10:00–10:30 10% -> 50% then pause.

Kari (marketing): Good call. Let's do that. I'll update the timeline and send the release copy shortly. Thanks all — will ping when copy is assembled.
